cells.gaps: No national law passed to give effect to the EAC Protocol on ICT Networks or another shared text is recorded; the date of ratification is not given. The Malabo Convention is not signed.
cells.note: Uganda's parliamentary foreign affairs committee said in November 2026 that Uganda has signed and ratified the EAC Protocol on ICT Networks (UGA-004); not signing Malabo is not stage 1 where another text is ratified. No law giving effect to it is reported, so not 4.
